description: This file defines the OutputBufferingMiddleware class for the Slim Framework, which manages output buffering and modifies the response body based on the buffering style (append or prepend). It implements PSR-15 MiddlewareInterface and interacts with PSR-7 response objects.

classes.name: OutputBufferingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware for buffering, modifying, and injecting output into HTTP responses based on specified style (append or prepend).

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the middleware with a stream factory and buffering style, validating the style parameter.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the request by starting output buffering, processing the request, capturing buffered output, and then modifying the response body accordingly based on the style.
